data.notes: As of October 13, Bali’s confirmed October calendar is strongest around Savaya/Zumana’s international electronic bookings, Potato Head/Klymax’s selector-led programming, and Afro/Latin diaspora parties around Halloween.

events.title: Zamna Bali at Savaya
events.summary: Zamna returns to Savaya for two days: October 17 focuses on house and techno with 19:26, Brina Knauss, Innellea and ZSS, while October 18 moves into Afro house with Djeff, Moojo, Nitefreak and Vanco.

events.title: Fallen Wonderland Halloween Weekend at Savaya
events.summary: Savaya confirms a three-day Halloween weekend from October 30 to November 1, with Jonas Blue on Friday, Hayden James on Saturday and a costume contest on Sunday.

events.title: Diplo at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Diplo played a one-night Savaya Bali show on October 8, with RA listing the event as a house/deep-house booking at the Uluwatu cliff club.

events.title: ARTBAT at Zumana Bali
events.summary: Zumana’s official event page confirms Ukrainian melodic-techno duo ARTBAT for Friday, October 16, with Megatix tickets linked from the venue page.

events.title: Beatland World Beatbox Battle 2026
events.summary: Beatland brings solo and loopstation beatbox finals to BLOCK42 at Nuanu on October 17, with the programme running into an afterparty after midnight and a confirmed ONYX live appearance listed on ticketing sources.

events.title: Junction: Africa Vol. 9
events.summary: The Mesa Bali and Afrobeats Asia present a three-day, three-floor Afro-diaspora weekend with DJ Miro, DJ Obas, DJ Ola, Vebo, Goatee, Rhyno, JB Smooth and supporting DJs across Gqom, Amapiano, Afro Tech and Afrobeats-driven club sounds.

events.title: Evolving Landscapes: Rostarr at Potato Head Beach Club
events.summary: Desa Potato Head’s Rostarr launch turns the Beach Club into an open-air dancefloor with Suze Ijó, Alex From Tokyo, Eric Duncan, Ryosuke Fukunaga, Yuka Mizuhara and Archie, before the programme continues inside Klymax.

events.title: Franky Wah at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Franky Wah is confirmed for Savaya on Saturday, October 24, with RA tagging the show as house and techno at the Uluwatu venue.

events.title: TRANSIT x Nuanu: Halloween Pre-Party
events.summary: Bali collective TRANSIT takes over Block42 at Nuanu with Schacke, Dior, 0OBSCENE, Sanjonas, Anelle and a secret guest for fast techno, experimental club, hard club, bass and broken-rhythm sounds.

events.title: Biggest Latin Beach Festival — Yonaguni Fiesta x Atlas Beach Club
events.summary: Atlas Beach Club confirms a Yonaguni Fiesta collaboration built around Latin sounds, beachfront dancing and a 6 PM event start on October 16.

events.title: Disko Afrika: Night of the Shadows
events.summary: Disko Afrika’s Halloween edition lands at Desa Kitsuné, extending the collective’s Bali Afro-diaspora party lane into a ticketed night built around African and Afro-Caribbean club energy.

events.title: DJ Fett Burger & Telephones, Archie at Klymax Discotheque
events.summary: Klymax hosts Norwegian selectors DJ Fett Burger and Telephones back-to-back with Archie on October 23, with RA listing a 10 PM to 4 AM session.

events.title: DJ BORING, Dita at Klymax Discotheque
events.summary: Klymax’s October run opened with Australian selector DJ BORING alongside Indonesia-based Dita, leaning into house, techno, electro, acid, proto-house, breaks, and Balearic-adjacent club sounds.

events.title: Nitefreak at Zumana Bali
events.summary: Zumana’s official page confirms Zimbabwean Afro-house artist Nitefreak for Wednesday, October 21 at the Kuta beach-club venue.

events.title: Bell Towers, Jonathan Kusuma, Seabass at Klymax Discotheque
events.summary: Klymax closes October with Bell Towers, Jonathan Kusuma and Seabass, drawing on sample disco, leftfield house, proto-techno, darker late-night grooves and Bali’s audiophile dance-floor culture.

events.title: General Levy — Live in Bali
events.summary: UK jungle and dancehall MC General Levy is confirmed for a live set at BLOCK42 in Nuanu Creative City, with support DJs and an afterparty focused on jungle, dancehall, reggae, dub and bass music.

events.title: ARGY at Zumana Bali
events.summary: Zumana’s official event page confirms ARGY for Wednesday, October 14, with paid tickets at the Kuta beach-club venue.

events.title: Vanco at Zumana Bali
events.summary: RA confirms Afro-house/Afro-tech artist Vanco at Zumana Bali on Friday, October 23, with the event promoted by Zumana Bali.

events.title: Hayden James at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Australian electronic artist Hayden James is confirmed for a Halloween-night headline set at Savaya Bali on October 31, 2026. The official Savaya event page lists doors at 3:00 PM.

events.title: Alex Wann at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Paris-based Alex Wann brings Afro-leaning melodic/deep house to Savaya’s cliffside dayclub format, a strong destination booking for Bali’s Afro-house and melodic-house crowd.

events.title: Shivanna Halloween Party
events.venueName: The Shivanna - Benoa Check In Point
events.summary: The Shivanna Halloween Party is confirmed for October 31, 2026, as a sunset cruise from Benoa Harbour. The ticket page lists a live DJ, fire dance, canapés, and a four-hour sailing format.

events.title: Boat Vibes Bali Vol. 4
events.venueName: The Shivanna - Benoa Check In Point
events.summary: Boat Vibes Bali Vol. 4 is a confirmed sunset cruise from Benoa Harbour on October 10, 2026, billed with a live DJ and fire dance. The itinerary runs as a four-hour sailing event along the Nusa Dua coastline.
